source_scenarios.description: The request can be answered from stable general knowledge, reasoning, supplied information, or ordinary conversation.
The request needs a focused external lookup, current fact, public status, navigation result, or specific verification.
The request explicitly requires investigation, comparison, or synthesis across multiple current external sources.
The request materially depends on the user's own project, repository, source files, implementation, or project-specific symbol.

task_scenarios.description: Ordinary question answering, explanation, advice, conversation, writing, summarization, navigation, or factual response.
Explain an existing function, class, component, interface, source file, or implementation.
Diagnose an error, malfunction, traceback, incorrect result, or unexpected behavior.
Write, modify, refactor, extend, or patch code.
Design systems, infrastructure, deployment, migrations, service boundaries, or major technical tradeoffs.
Investigate and synthesize evidence or findings from multiple sources.

freshness_scenarios.description: The answer should not materially change merely because time passes.
The answer materially depends on information that may have changed recently.
The isolated prompt lacks enough context to determine whether freshness matters.

complexity_scenarios.description: Focused task requiring little decomposition or sustained reasoning.
Normal professional or everyday reasoning with moderate depth.
Substantial multi-stage reasoning, interacting constraints, tradeoffs, or synthesis.
